Name: (FF)or(CP)or (CP)(AT)xiaxia - Cute Furniture
Author: catissocute
Description:
[quote]这些可爱家具的作者是[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/1352290156?gameId=1303]xiaxia[/url]﻿﻿，请尊重原创作者，不要二改二传。如果你喜欢这些家具，请前往她的主页进行支持。[/quote]
非常感谢[u][size=3]xiaxia老师[/size][/u]（小红书：女儿国国王，ID9501089863）同意我们对她的家具进行1.6更新，也非常感谢[u][size=3]猫柚chocolate[/size][/u]（小红书ID2376124533）制作的FF代码❤，并且在她的帮助下，我也进一步完善了CP代码。我的小红书账号是咪咪最可爱了（ID5567253356）[u]欢迎来找我玩!![/u]

[center]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center]
[center]这个mod是对xiaxia所画家具进行的1.6更新，分为FF、CP-AT、CP三种模式，请﻿﻿选择喜欢的模式进行下载。[/center][left][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]﻿【FF】（强烈推荐）[/size][/font]
一、在原版家具的基础上增加了额外功能
[list=1]
[*]房车：角色可以坐下（如展示图所示）；减少了房车两边的碰撞体积，以更容易通过
[*]娃娃机：角色可以在中间穿过（站着或者坐下，如展示图所示）
[*]野餐垫：增加了旋转样式
[*]娃娃：减少了两边的碰撞体积，便于布置农舍
[/list]二、在哪里找到这些家具：
[list=1]
[*]快乐家居：除了野餐垫在地毯分类，其他家具都在[u]柜子[/u]分类
[*]CJB
[/list][/left] 
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]【CP-AT】/【CP】[/size][/font]
一、这两种模式的家具仅对原版家具进行了新版本更新，增加了地毯的旋转样式，其他没有任何变化。
二、在哪里找到这些家具：
[list=1]
[*]快乐家居：除了野餐垫在地毯分类，其他家具都在[u]装饰[/u]分类。
[*]CJB
[/list] 三、纯CP文件适用于移动端玩家。
另外，房车有二十几种，展示图仅仅列出了其中一部分。

[size=6][b]English[/b]：[/size]
[quote][size=3]These cute furniture were created by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/1352290156?gameId=1303]xiaxia[/url]﻿. Please respect the original author and do not redistribute or plagiarize the
images.
If you enjoy them, please visit her homepage to show your support.[/size][/quote]
[size=3]Many thanks to xiaxia for allowing us to update her furniture for version 1.6, and heartfelt gratitude to 猫柚chocolate for creating the FF code❤. With her assistance, I also update the CP code again.[/size]

[center]--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]This mod provides a 1.6 update for xiaxia’s cute furniture, available in both FF and CP.
Please choose your preferred version to download.  [/size][/font][/center][size=3] [/size]
[b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]【FF】(Highly Recommended)[/size][/font][/b]

[size=3]◆Added functionalities to original furniture:
1. Camper Van: Characters can now sit (as shown in previews); Reduced collision boxes on both sides for easier passage
2. Claw Machine: Characters can now walk through the center (stand or sit in the middle as shown in previews)
3. Picnic Blanket: Added rotated style variations
4. Dolls: Reduced side collision boxes for easier farmhouse decoration
◆How to locate these items:
1.Happy Home Designer
All furniture can be found in the [u][b]Bookcase category[/b][/u] except the Picnic Blanket
2.CJB[/size]
 
 
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b]【CP-AT】/【CP】[/b][/size][/font]
[size=3]◆The furniture in these two modes has only been updated to new versions for the original designs, adding rotatable carpet styles, with no other changes.
The only CP file are available for mobile players.
◆How to locate these items:
1. Happy Home Designer
All furniture can be found in the [b][u]Decor category[/u][/b] except the Picnic Blanket
2.CJB[/size]
 
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]Additionally, there are over 20 variants of the Camper Van; the preview images only showcase a selection of them.[/size][/font]
